activities.name: Tandem Paragliding over the Interlaken Lakes
activities.description: You will launch from the alpine meadows of Beatenberg and soar high above Interlaken, catching unparalleled aerial views of Lake Thun, Lake Brienz, and the iconic Eiger, Mönch, and Jungfrau peaks. Your certified pilot handles the glider while you experience the ultimate adrenaline rush and a peaceful glide down to the Höhematte park. It is a defining Swiss alpine thrill that provides a bird's-eye perspective of the valley.
activities.duration_note: Operates year-round weather permitting. Advance booking required. Max weight limits apply (typically 90-100kg). Swiss Travel Pass holders do not get discounts on flights but may save on local transit to the meeting point.

activities.name: Top of Europe Cogwheel Railway Excursion
activities.description: You will ride the historic rack railway tunnel through the Eiger mountain to reach Europe's highest altitude railway station at 3,454 meters. Step out onto the Sphinx Observatory terrace to witness the vast Aletsch Glacier stretching before you, and walk through the tunnels of the Ice Palace carved directly into the glacier. The thinning alpine air and brutal, majestic icy wilderness create an unforgettable high-altitude sensory experience.
activities.duration_note: Operates year-round. Extremely weather dependent; check live webcams before ascending. Swiss Travel Pass offers a 25% discount from Wengen/Grindelwald upwards and free travel up to those points. Dress in heavy winter layers even in July.

activities.name: E-Bike Trekking Through the 72 Waterfalls Valley
activities.description: You will cruise on a premium electric mountain bike along the flat floor of a dramatic U-shaped glacial valley, flanked by vertical 300-meter stone cliffs. Stop to explore the subterranean Trümmelbach Falls, where thunderous glacial meltwater carves through the inside of the mountain, and look up to see Staubbach Falls misting over the landscape. It offers a liberating, self-paced way to soak in one of the most cinematic valleys on earth.
activities.duration_note: Best from May to October. Price includes e-bike rental, helmet, and entry ticket to Trümmelbach Falls. Swiss Travel Pass grants free train travel to Lauterbrunnen but no discount on the private bike rentals.

activities.name: Mount Pilatus Golden Round Trip
activities.description: You will experience an intricate loop of transport starting with a historic lake steamboat cruise across Lake Lucerne to Alpnachstad. From there, you will ascend the steepest cogwheel railway in the world (48% gradient) to the jagged summit of Mount Pilatus for sweeping panoramic vistas over central Switzerland. Your journey finishes with a spectacular descent via the 'Dragon Ride' aerial cableway and panorama gondolas down to Kriens.
activities.duration_note: The full Golden Round Trip operates from May to October when the cogwheel railway is clear of snow. In winter, the mountain is accessed solely via gondolas from Kriens. Swiss Travel Pass covers the boat ride completely and provides a 50% discount on the mountain railways.

activities.name: Jet Boat Thrill Ride to Giessbach Falls
activities.description: You will strap into a high-powered jet boat and skim across the turquoise, glacier-fed waters of Lake Brienz at high speeds, experiencing exhilarating 360-degree spins executed by an expert captain. The boat cruises right up to the base of the majestic Giessbach Falls, where roaring water tumbles across 14 tiers into the lake. It beautifully pairs heart-pounding adventure with jaw-dropping, fairytale natural scenery.
activities.duration_note: Operates from April to October. Rain gear and life jackets are fully provided. Minimum age is 5 years. Advance reservations are highly recommended due to limited group capacities per boat.

activities.name: Traditional Emmental Cheese & Fondue Experience at Lötschberger
activities.description: You will step into Restaurant Lötschberger in Bern's UNESCO-listed Old Town to indulge in an authentic Swiss cheese feast. Swirl fresh bread cubes and baby potatoes into a bubbling, rich pot of traditional fondue made from local, cave-aged Emmentaler and Le Gruyère AOP cheeses melted down with dry white wine and garlic. It is a warm, deeply comforting cultural ritual that highlights the finest of Swiss dairy craftsmanship.
activities.duration_note: Available year-round. Evening reservations are strictly mandatory, particularly during winter months. Vegetarian-friendly, but traditional fondue contains alcohol (Kirsch and white wine).

activities.name: Craft Cocktails at Hemingway Lounge & Bar
activities.description: You will spend your evening tucked into the sophisticated, leather-and-wood atmosphere of the iconic Hemingway Lounge in the heart of Lucerne. Sip on meticulously crafted classic cocktails, premium Swiss whiskeys, and custom infusions mixed by award-winning bartenders while jazz music sets a moody tone. It is the premier spot in Central Switzerland to unwind and socialize after a rigorous day of alpine exploration.
activities.duration_note: Open year-round, Tuesday through Saturday nights. Smart casual dress code enforced. Cocktails generally average 18 to 26 CHF each, reflecting upscale Swiss night prices.

activities.name: Mineral Baths & Spa Day above Lake Lucerne
activities.description: You will soak in therapeutic, mineral-rich thermal waters designed by world-renowned architect Mario Botta, situated high on the ridges of Mount Rigi. Swim from the indoor pool out into the crisp mountain air of the outdoor pool, where you will float while gazing at vast alpine ranges and the deep blue of Lake Lucerne below. The complex features crystal baths, steam rooms, and saunas designed for pure mountain rejuvenation.
activities.duration_note: Operates year-round. Swiss Travel Pass completely covers the mountain trains and cable cars to reach Rigi Kaltbad, making transit to the spa free, though spa admission is a separate charge.

activities.name: Fraumünster & Grossmünster Historic Walking Tour
activities.description: You will stroll through the winding cobblestone alleyways of Zurich's old town, stopping first at the Fraumünster Church to stand in awe before the world-famous, vividly colored stained-glass windows designed by Marc Chagall. Next, cross the Limmat River to climb the iconic twin towers of Grossmünster, the birthplace of the Swiss-German Reformation, for a panoramic view over the city roofs and the lake. It bridges masterful art with centuries of deep religious and political history.
activities.location: Zunfthaus zur Meisen meeting point, Zurich Old Town
activities.duration_note: Available year-round. Modest clothing covering shoulders and knees is expected inside the active churches. Tower climb at Grossmünster requires navigating 187 tight stairs.

activities.name: Zürcher Geschnetzeltes Culinary Tasting at Zeughauskeller
activities.description: You will dine inside a historic 15th-century former stone armory to taste Zurich's signature dish: Zürcher Geschnetzeltes. Feast on tender, thinly sliced veal strips pan-seared and smothered in a rich, creamy white wine and mushroom sauce, served alongside a massive, crispy, golden Swiss Rösti (shredded potato cake). The roaring, beer-hall atmosphere and heavy rustic tables connect you directly with classic German-Swiss culinary traditions.
activities.duration_note: Open year-round. Highly popular with both locals and travelers; table bookings are recommended weeks in advance for dinner services.

activities.name: Lindt Home of Chocolate Masterclass & Museum Tour
activities.description: You will marvel at the world's largest, spectacular 9-meter-tall free-standing chocolate fountain before diving into an interactive, high-tech exhibition tracing cocoa from bean to bar. Sample unlimited white, milk, and dark Swiss chocolate at various tasting stations throughout the facility, and watch master chocolatiers at work creating delicate truffles. It is a decadent, modern homage to Switzerland's global chocolate legacy.
activities.duration_note: Operates year-round. Audio guides are included. Tickets sell out weeks in advance; online pre-booking for specific timed slots is mandatory. Swiss Travel Pass gets you to the venue via train/boat but does not cover museum entry.

activities.name: Rhine Falls Boat Cruise to the Central Rock
activities.description: You will stand over the viewing platforms at Europe's most powerful waterfall, feeling the ground shake as hundreds of thousands of liters of water plunge down every second. Board a sturdy, specially designed rock-rider boat that navigates the roaring foam to drop you off at the razor-thin central rock cliff standing defiant in the middle of the falls. Climb the steep steps to the top of the rock for an intense, 360-degree spray-filled encounters with nature's raw force.
activities.duration_note: The boat excursions operate from April to October; viewing platforms remain open year-round. Swiss Travel Pass covers the train journeys to the stations on either side of the falls (Schloss Laufen or Neuhausen).

activities.name: Industrial Nightlife Crawl at Hive Club
activities.description: You will dive deep into Zurich's cutting-edge electronic music subculture within the trendy, industrial-chic Zurich West district at Hive. Dance until dawn across three distinct rooms blasting world-class techno and deep house curation, surrounded by quirky art installations and high-tech lighting rigs. It represents the gritty, creative, and energetic nightlife identity that sets Zurich apart from standard conservative Swiss tropes.
activities.duration_note: Open Fridays and Saturdays from midnight until late morning. Must be 21 or older for entry; strict photo ID checks are performed at the door. Dress down in casual, club-ready attire.

activities.name: Mount Säntis Ridge Hike & Ebenalp Ebenalp Excursion
activities.description: You will travel to the rugged Alpstein region to ascend Mount Säntis via cable car, looking out over six European countries on clear days. From there, hike down dramatic alpine paths toward Ebenalp to witness the iconic, historic Aescher Cliffside Restaurant clinging precariously to a vertical rock face under a cavern. This trek combines dramatic geomorphology with postcard-perfect Swiss architectural ingenuity.
activities.duration_note: Cable cars operate year-round, but the mountain trails are strictly seasonal, safe only from June to October. Solid hiking boots with deep tread and walking poles are strongly advised.

activities.name: Sailing Regatta Experience on Lake Zurich
activities.description: You will board a sleek, modern racing yacht guided by an expert skipper to actively trim the sails and steer across the sparkling expanses of Lake Zurich. Take in the grand city skyline, vineyard-lined shores, and distant, snow-capped Glarus Alps as you harness the afternoon breezes. It is an active, elegant way to experience Zurich's affluent lake lifestyle firsthand.
activities.duration_note: Available from May to late September. No prior sailing experience is required. Bring non-marking soft rubber-soled shoes and a windbreaker. Book well in advance for weekend slots.

activities.name: Tamina Thermal Gorge Wellness Immersion
activities.description: You will journey to the cradle of Swiss spa culture, entering the atmospheric Tamina Gorge where healing, 36.5 degree Celsius thermal water springs directly out of deep mountain caverns. Transition into the ultra-luxurious Tamina Therme public bath complex to soak in indoor and outdoor whirlpools, currents, and custom sauna ceremonies. It offers an elite, deeply therapeutic retreat focused on relaxation and structural physical recovery.
activities.duration_note: Open year-round. Ticket price covers standard 2-hour or 4-hour bath access; massages and extensive sauna village access cost extra. Swiss Travel Pass gets you to Bad Ragaz station for free.

activities.name: Matterhorn Glacier Paradise Cable Car Ride
activities.description: You will ascend to Europe's highest cable car station at an astonishing 3,883 meters, floating past jagged mountain walls in a modern crystal-encrusted cabin. Step out onto the panoramic 360-degree observation deck for jaw-dropping close-up views of the dramatic, pyramidal Matterhorn and 37 other alpine giants. Walk through glacial ice tunnels located 15 meters below the surface to see glowing ice carvings and massive crevasses.
activities.duration_note: Operates year-round, though closed during severe winds. High altitude warning: physical exertion feels tougher here. Swiss Travel Pass cuts ticket costs by 50%.

activities.name: Guided Great Aletsch Glacier Ice Trek
activities.description: You will strap on professional crampons, tie into a secure mountaineering rope team, and step onto the ice of the Great Aletsch Glacier—the largest glacier in the Alps. Led by an expert local mountain guide, you will navigate winding ice ridges, stare down into brilliant turquoise meltwater crevasses, and learn about the intense glaciology of this UNESCO world heritage site. It is an active, awe-inspiring trek deep into a rapidly changing frozen world.
activities.location: Fiescheralp Cable Car Station meeting point
activities.duration_note: Runs strictly from mid-June to mid-October. Requires a good level of physical fitness and sure-footedness. Crampons and harnesses are fully provided; you must wear rigid hiking boots.

activities.name: Gorge Alpine Via Ferrata Night Expedition
activities.description: You will clip your harness into steel safety cables and traverse an immense, steep river canyon under the starry night sky, navigating rock faces via iron rungs, ladders, and rope bridges. Feel your heart race as you fly across the canyon darkness on high-speed zip lines and drop via a thrilling pendulum swing, guided safely by headlamps and a certified pro. It is a world-class, visceral evening adventure set in a dramatic geological trench.
activities.duration_note: Available winter and summer seasons via specialized evening tours. Requires zero advanced climbing skills but absolute freedom from vertigo is mandatory. All safety gear is provided.

activities.name: Valaisan Raclette Scraping & Wine Tasting Tour
activities.description: You will tour the ancient stone cellars of Les Celliers de Sion, learning about the steep, sun-drenched terraced vineyards of the Rhône Valley. Sit down for a masterclass where half-wheels of local raw-milk Raclette cheese are melted under a specialized heat lamp, allowing you to scrape the creamy, bubbly, charred layers directly onto your plate alongside cornichons and pickled pearl onions. Each course is paired expertly with crisp, rare local Fendant and Dôle wines.
activities.duration_note: Available year-round. Advance booking is requested. Great experience for wine enthusiasts seeking to sample hyper-regional Swiss grape varieties that are rarely exported.

activities.name: Après-Ski Legends Live Music at Hennu Stall
activities.description: You will experience Switzerland's rowdiest and most famous après-ski culture firsthand on the lower slopes of Zermatt's resort network. Ski right up to the venue or walk up the trail to join hundreds of energized travelers dancing on outdoor tables to roaring live bands and Euro-pop DJs while Jaeger-trains pour down the bar. It is an unmissable, high-energy alpine party tradition that bridges a hard day on the snow with vibrant nightlife.
activities.duration_note: Open during the winter ski season (late November to April) daily from 2 PM to 8 PM. Entry is completely free, but drinks are notoriously expensive (10-15 CHF per beer/shot).

activities.name: Leukerbad Thermal Alpine Oasis Soak
activities.description: You will soak your muscles inside Europe's largest high-altitude thermal resort complex, fed by 3.9 million liters of naturally warm mineral waters daily. Float effortlessly in the outdoor pools while massive, sheer limestone cliffs of the Daubenhorn mountain tower thousands of feet directly over your head. The therapeutic mountain waters and dramatic alpine walls create a perfect, tranquil sensory escape from active physical adventures.
activities.duration_note: Open year-round. Highly recommended after completing long treks or a heavy ski weekend. Swiss Travel Pass covers the public bus from Leuk train station up the steep switchbacks to Leukerbad.

activities.name: Rowing Tour Across Europe's Largest Underground Lake
activities.description: You will descend into a hidden underground world to board a large rowboat navigating the serene, crystal-clear waters of Saint-Léonard's subterranean lake. Gliding silently beneath a massive vault of solid rock, you will look down into illuminated turquoise waters to spot swimming trout, while a guide explains the unique tectonic shifts that formed this cave. It offers an eerie, calm, and fascinating break from the blinding mountain sun above.
activities.duration_note: Operates daily from March to November. The cave sits at a constant temperature of 15 degrees Celsius, so a light sweater is recommended. Advance online booking is highly recommended.

activities.name: Verbier Extreme Freeride Ski/Snowboard Guiding
activities.description: You will strap into your powder gear and follow a legendary, UIAGM-certified mountain guide down the technical, unpatrolled freeride itineraries of Verbier, including the infamous Mont Gelé face. Carve through deep powder fields, navigate steep couloirs, and experience the pure adrenaline of backcountry big-mountain riding in its spiritual birthplace. It is an intense, elite challenge reserved for advanced riders seeking the pinacle of Swiss winter sport.
activities.location: Médran Cable Car Station meeting point, Verbier
activities.duration_note: Strictly winter season, typically January to April. Price is for an expert private guide for up to 4 people; avalanche safety gear (transceiver, shovel, probe, airbag) is mandatory and extra.

activities.name: CERN Science Gateway & Large Hadron Collider Exhibition
activities.description: You will explore the frontiers of human physics at the stunning, Renzo Piano-designed CERN Science Gateway. Walk through immersive, high-tech exhibitions showing true-to-scale components of the world's largest particle accelerators, step inside interactive quantum chambers, and discover how scientists unraveled the Higgs Boson particle. It is an intellectual, visionary experience that details Geneva's role as a global scientific capital.
activities.duration_note: Open Tuesday through Sunday. Entry is completely free for all individuals, but guided lab tours require registering via the CERN app precisely 2 hours before arrival on-site.

activities.name: Château de Chillon Medieval Fortress Exploration
activities.description: You will step back into the 12th century as you cross the drawbridge of Switzerland's most visited historic monument, which sits dramatically on a rock island right in Lake Geneva. Explore the dark gothic underground vaults that famously inspired Lord Byron's poetry, stroll through grand banqueting halls, and climb medieval defensive wooden towers for vistas of the lake and mountains. It perfectly balances pristine medieval history with striking romance.
activities.duration_note: Open year-round. Swiss Travel Pass completely covers admission (100% free entry). Audio guides are available in multiple languages for a small fee.

activities.name: UNESCO Lavaux Wine Terraces Hiking & Tasting
activities.description: You will hike along gentle stone paths winding through 800 hectares of terraced, UNESCO-protected hillside vineyards that plunge steeply into the blue of Lake Geneva. Stop at a local family-run cave in the historic village of Epesses to sample crisp, mineral-heavy Chasselas white wine poured directly by the winemaker. The striking contrast between green vines, ancient stone walls, and the alpine lake makes it one of Europe's most visually stunning walks.
activities.duration_note: Best from May to October when wine cellars and seasonal pop-up bars are open. Walking the trails is 100% free; prices represent structured wine tasting flights in local cellars.

activities.name: Fresh Filet de Perche Dining at Café du Port
activities.description: You will sit on a lakeside terrace in Lausanne's Ouchy marina district to feast on Filet de Perche, the quintessential culinary delicacy of Lake Geneva. Enjoy delicate, small perch fillets caught fresh daily by local fishermen, lightly pan-fried in a rich, velvety lemon-butter sauce and sprinkled with capers, served alongside matchstick fries. Paired with a local glass of crisp Vaudois white wine, it is the absolute pinnacle of French-Swiss lakeside dining.
activities.duration_note: Available year-round, but highly magical on summer evenings. Make sure to verify the perch is locally caught ('du lac'), as cheaper imports can sometimes be found in lesser venues.

activities.name: Rooftop Cocktails at MET Rooftop Lounge
activities.description: You will elevate your evening by ascending to the top of the luxury Hotel Metropole, looking out over the illuminated Jet d'Eau fountain and Geneva's upscale harbor. Sip on bespoke signature cocktails and premium champagne infusions while listening to smooth lounge beats curated by live weekend DJs. It is the premier gathering hub for Geneva's elite, cosmopolitan crowd, encapsulating the sleek luxury of the city.
activities.duration_note: Open late spring through early autumn, weather permitting. Smart elegant dress code strictly enforced (no sportswear, open shoes for men). Cocktails start around 24 CHF.

activities.name: Belle Époque Steamboat Lake Cruise
activities.description: You will step onto a beautifully restored, century-old historical paddle steamboat operated by the CGN line, feeling the gentle thrum of the vintage steam engine beneath the deck. Cruise past lavish lakeside villas, rolling vineyards, and towering peaks of the French Alps framing the water. It offers an elegant, slow-paced journey that feels like stepping right back into Europe's luxurious Gilded Age.
activities.duration_note: Full schedule runs from June to September; winter schedules are drastically reduced. Swiss Travel Pass completely covers standard 2nd-class and 1st-class tickets on scheduled CGN boats.

activities.name: Windsurfing & Kayaking at Genève-Plage
activities.description: You will hit the water at Geneva's premium lakeside beach complex, launching a professional windsurf rig or sleek sea kayak right onto Lake Geneva. Paddle out to catch the spray from the massive Jet d'Eau fountain, or harness the thermal winds blowing across the bay while taking in the city skyline. It is an active, refreshing athletic escape right in the center of the bustling international city.
activities.duration_note: Open from May to September. Price represents park entry plus 1-hour windsurf or high-end kayak rental gear. Changing rooms, lockers, and swimming pools are available on-site.

activities.name: Les Bains de Lavey Thermal Well-being Night
activities.description: You will immerse yourself in the hottest thermal waters in Switzerland, pumped from deep underground directly into an expansive, beautifully illuminated open-air mountain pool complex. Relax beneath starry skies as under-water music, high-pressure massaging jets, and bubbling currents soothe your body. The dramatic night lighting and therapeutic heat beneath the alpine walls create an ethereal, relaxing wellness experience.
activities.duration_note: Open year-round. Especially magical when visited during winter snowfalls or late at night (open until 9 PM or 10 PM depending on the weekday). Entry covers a 3-hour bath pass.

activities.name: 007 James Bond GoldenEye Bungee Jump
activities.description: You will stand on the narrow edge of the colossal 220-meter-tall Contra Dam in the Verzasca Valley, mirroring the iconic opening stunt from the James Bond film 'GoldenEye'. Throw yourself forward into pure weightlessness, plunging straight down along the massive concrete dam wall before the elastic cord catches you in a smooth bounce. It is widely ranked among the most intense, pure adrenaline commercial bungee jumps on the planet.
activities.duration_note: Operates from Easter to October, weekends primarily, with daily jumps in July/August. Advance booking is mandatory. Strict medical, age, and weight requirements (min 45kg, max 115kg) apply.

activities.name: Bellinzona Three Medieval Castles Siege Tour
activities.description: You will explore an imposing, UNESCO-listed defensive wall system starting with the grand Castelgrande, situated on a rocky peak right above the town center. Walk through high stone battlements and climb defensive watchtowers before taking secret mountain paths up to the higher fortresses of Montebello and Sasso Corbaro. This monumental fortifications complex offers a unique glimpse into the historical clash of Swiss and Italian cultures.
activities.duration_note: Castles are open year-round. Swiss Travel Pass completely covers admission to all museums and internal castle complexes (100% free entry). Expect heavy walking up steep stone inclines.

activities.name: Swimming & Diving at the Ponte dei Salti Emerald Pools
activities.description: You will walk across the centuries-old, double-arched stone bridge 'Ponte dei Salti' before jumping or climbing down into the crystal-clear, striking emerald green waters of the Verzasca River. Relax on massive, smooth, sun-warmed white granite rocks that have been sculpted over millennia by glacial water currents. It is a stunning natural paradise that feels entirely distinct from the snowy high-alpine image of northern Switzerland.
activities.duration_note: Best from June to September. The river is entry-free, but parking is strictly paid. Warning: currents can be dangerous and water is shockingly cold even in August; swim with caution.

activities.name: Authentic Ticinese Risotto Cooking Masterclass at Grotto Morisoli
activities.description: You will gather inside a traditional stone 'Grotto' restaurant hidden beneath shady trees to master the art of Italian-Swiss slow-cooked risotto. Under the eye of a local chef, cook premium Carnaroli rice infused with local Merlot wine, rich saffron, and regional alpine cheeses until perfectly creamy. Sit at rustic stone tables to devour your creation alongside artisanal cured meats and local Vallemaggia pepper cheese.
activities.duration_note: Available from April to October. Minimum group sizes are usually required to run the culinary class. Includes full meal, cooking instruction, and local wine pairings.

activities.name: Lakeside Mixology at Seven Lugano The Lounge
activities.description: You will dive into the sleek, trendy Italian-influenced nightlife of Ticino at the upscale Seven Lounge, located right on the banks of Lake Lugano. Enjoy artisanal tropical cocktails and premium Italian prosecco while lounging on plush outdoor sofas as palms rustle in the warm Mediterranean breeze. It is the premier nightlife spot to see and be seen, offering a stylish, vibrant transition from day to night.
activities.duration_note: Open year-round, expanding significantly outdoors during summer. Smart casual dress code. Great spot to catch local Italian-Swiss electronic and chill-out DJs on weekends.

activities.name: Stand-Up Paddleboarding to Gandria Village
activities.description: You will rent a premium stand-up paddleboard from the shores of Lugano and glide across the glass-like water to the historic, car-free cliffside fishing village of Gandria. Paddle past ancient pastel houses stacked steeply over the water, tie up your board at a stone pier, and explore narrow alleys bursting with flowers. It offers an active, slow, and uniquely intimate perspective of this sun-drenched border landscape.
activities.location: Lido di Lugano boat rental station
activities.duration_note: Best from May to September when the lake waters are warm. Life vests are included with board rentals. Basic swimming competency is strictly required.

activities.name: Monte San Salvatore Funicular & Ridge Walk
activities.description: You will ascend Lugano's iconic mini-Sugarloaf mountain via a steep, historic funicular railway. From the summit, take in a breathtaking, 360-degree look at the intricate bays of Lake Lugano twisting below and the distant plains of northern Italy. Walk down the scenic ridge trail toward Carona, strolling past sweet chestnut forests and historic stone chapels that radiate Mediterranean flair.
activities.duration_note: Funicular runs from March to November. Swiss Travel Pass holders receive a 50% discount on the funicular ticket price. The subsequent walk to Carona requires comfortable footwear.

activities.name: The Cresta Run Historical Toboggan Experience
activities.description: You will witness or dare to try the birthplace of modern winter skeleton racing on the legendary, natural-ice Cresta Run track. Ride head-first on a heavy steel toboggan, steering using specialized rakes on your boots, navigating the terrifying 'Shuttlecock' corner where speed control is critical. It is a wildly exclusive, historically rich club experience that delivers unmatched speed and old-world British-Swiss winter racing prestige.
activities.duration_note: Strictly limited to winter (mid-December to early March). Beginner sessions for non-members are incredibly rare, expensive, and require advance booking months ahead. Men-only riding tradition remains for standard courses; strict safety screenings apply.

activities.name: Swiss National Park Wilderness Expedition
activities.description: You will hike through Switzerland's only official National Park, an alpine nature reserve where strict protection laws have left the landscape completely untouched for over a century. Walk along pristine pine trails to spot golden eagles soaring overhead, bearded vultures, bearded chamois, and massive herds of wild red deer. The total absence of human infrastructure offers an authentic, raw encounter with ancient alpine ecosystems.
activities.duration_note: Park trails are accessible from June to October. Entry to the park is completely free. Visitors must strictly stay on designated paths; picking flowers or leaving trash carries massive fines.

activities.name: Bernina Express Panoramic Train Journey
activities.description: You will ride in a futuristic panoramic train car along the highest railway line across the Alps, climbing to 2,253 meters without the help of any rack-and-cogwheel gears. Marvel at the spectacular Morteratsch Glacier, spiral down the architectural marvel of the Brusio Circular Viaduct, and watch high alpine snow fields transform into Italian vineyards within hours. It is globally ranked among the most beautiful, engineering-forward train routes ever built.
activities.location: St. Moritz Railway Station to Tirano
activities.duration_note: Operates year-round. Swiss Travel Pass covers the base ticket price 100%, but a separate, mandatory seat reservation fee (approx. 20-30 CHF) must be paid and booked months ahead.

activities.name: Bündner Nusstorte Pastry Tasting at Meier Bakery
activities.description: You will travel to a picture-perfect, Romansh-style mountain village to taste Bündner Nusstorte, Graubünden's signature sweet delicacy. Indulge in a rich, buttery shortbread crust stuffed overflowing with chopped walnuts caramelized in thick honey, cream, and sugar. Paired with strong coffee inside an ancient house adorned with traditional sgraffito wall art, it connects you directly with the ancient culinary roots of mountain life.
activities.duration_note: Open year-round. Perfect reward stop during a trek through the Lower Engadin valley. You can buy whole torte boxes that keep fresh for weeks as excellent travel gifts.

activities.name: Elite Cigar & Single Malt Lounge at Devil's Place
activities.description: You will enter the Waldhaus am See hotel to spend your evening inside 'Devil's Place', officially home to the largest whisky collection in the world with over 2,500 varieties on display. Sip on hyper-rare scotch single malts, custom Swiss distillates, and fine Cuban cigars while looking out over the frozen or midnight-blue waters of Lake St. Moritz. It perfectly embodies the high-end, luxurious, and exclusive club atmosphere that defines St. Moritz nightlife.
activities.duration_note: Open year-round nightly. Smart upscale dress expected. Individual rare whisky dram prices can range from 12 CHF to thousands of francs for historical vintages.

activities.name: 72 Thermal Baths Vals Architectural Wellness Rejuvenation
activities.description: You will retreat to an elite architectural masterpiece designed by Peter Zumthor, constructed from 60,000 slabs of local grey quartzite stone built right into the mountain slopes. Bathe within mystical chambers ranging from icy 14-degree pools to steaming 42-degree waters, filled with mineral water that bubbles out of the ground. The striking minimalism, interplay of mountain light, and healing hot water create a meditative wellness experience.
activities.duration_note: Open year-round. Spa slots for outside day guests are strictly limited to prevent crowding; advance reservation online is absolutely mandatory weeks ahead.
